name: How long does it take to design and install a custom closet system?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to design and install a custom closet system?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for designing and installing a custom closet system can vary based on complexity and materials. Initial design consultations and revisions typically take 1-3 weeks. Once the design is finalized and materials are ordered, fabrication can take 4-8 weeks. Installation usually requires 1-3 days, depending on the size of the closet. The process begins with an in-home measurement and consultation to understand your specific needs and the unique dimensions of your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: The entire process, from design to installation, usually takes between 5 to 12 weeks, depending on the complexity and materials selected.
